summary: The PR addresses the issue of documenting methods decorated with both @classmethod and @property by modifying the autodoc extension. The changes appear to be minimal and directly related to the problem.

issues.description: The patch checks if the getter function of a property is a class method, but it does not handle other potential descriptors or combinations. This might not cover all edge cases involving multiple decorators.
The code style could be improved by using parentheses consistently and aligning the conditions for better readability.
